Henrik Nielsen is a biostatistician and data manager at Department 1 of the RKKP Knowledge Center (RKKP's Videncenter) [^src1]. He serves as a member of the steering committee for the Acute Surgery Database ([[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe|akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]]) [^src1]. In this capacity, Nielsen provides essential statistical and technical expertise, ensuring the rigorous handling of data and the accurate measurement of clinical quality indicators within the database [^src1]. 

His inclusion in the 2023 annual report's list of steering committee members illustrates the interdisciplinary and cross-regional governance structure that oversees the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) under the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. While the broader 2023 report discusses operational limitations, technical errors in registration systems, and coding practices across five Danish regions, Nielsen's specific role anchors the technical and statistical validity of the database's quality audits and research indicators [^src1].
